articles.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
articles.snippet: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
articles.snippet: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

articles.title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
articles.snippet: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.

articles.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
articles.snippet: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
articles.snippet: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.
